ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Identify two consumers in this food web that eat producers.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title of the food web is "TERRESTRIAL FOOD WEB". The producer "Grasses" is labeled at the bottom. Arrows starting from "Grasses" point to some animals, among which arrows pointing to "Insects" and "Rabbit" can be clearly seen. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows indicate the food source pointing to the eater, so the animals pointed to from grasses are the consumers that eat producers. The question only requires finding two, so insects and rabbit can be selected.
